input.text:
slayr went from 38.6K to 1.5M Spotify monthly listeners in 17 months, and three YouTube channels are on him this week. 🔥

The 19-year-old Philadelphia rapper and producer (Evan McDonald, born May 22, 2007) blew up on the back of his mixtape Half Blood, a trap, rage and digicore project he self-released on Nov 5, 2025. It was pulled on Jan 14, 2026 over a sample, then re-released on Columbia on Jan 20 and followed by the BloodLuxe edition on Mar 6 (Pitchfork 6.7, The Needle Drop 8/10).

This week's uploads: Lyrical Lemonade's official video for "Eyesight", Our Generation Music's beat breakdown of "Sloppy Joe", and PlaqueBoyMax's "1v1" video with slayr. He was in the 2026 XXL Freshman class and ran his first headline tour, Half Blood Tour, with 23 dates (Aug to Sep 2026).

The numbers: 38.6K listeners on May 20, 2025 (Wayback Machine snapshot), 473.1K on Feb 20, 2026, a peak of 1.7M around Aug 29, 2026, and 1.5M as of Oct 20, 2026. His top track on Spotify is "keep me going (BIRDBRAIN)", ahead of "Sloppy Joe" and "CONSTANTLY" with Tiffany Day.

Is slayr your next rage-rap pick? Tell us where he lands for you. 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners, Wayback Machine, Wikipedia, YouTube channel uploads · as of Oct 20, 2026
